授業概要
都市のリスク、特に地震によるリスクに関する論文のレビューをもとに、都市や建築の危険度評価や地震災害に強い都市や建築の在り方について研究する。
In this study, risk assessment of cities and buildings and cities and buildings resistant to earthquake disasters are studied based on the review of papers on urban risks, especially risks due to earthquakes.
